import ast, csv, hashlib, json, math, subprocess
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import urlopen
import numpy as np
root=Path('test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933')
out=root/'verification/upstream_row_split_identity_20260929_0236'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
revision='9cfddcedc9d1e00885c28db75a45513eddbb6271'
branch=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-remote','https://github.com/littlefatfat/sglang.git','refs/heads/simulator-data-tools-0914'],text=True,timeout=20).split()[0]
assert branch==revision
url=f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/littlefatfat/sglang/{revision}/tools/sglang-simulator/tools/train_latency_model.py'
with urlopen(url,timeout=20) as response:
    content=response.read()
(out/'upstream_train_latency_model.py').write_bytes(content)
tree=ast.parse(content.decode())
node=next(item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item,ast.FunctionDef) and item.name=='build_case_stratified_split')
parse=next(item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item,ast.FunctionDef) and item.name=='parse_args')
defaults={}
for item in ast.walk(parse):
    if isinstance(item,ast.Call) and isinstance(item.func,ast.Attribute) and item.func.attr=='add_argument' and item.args:
        if isinstance(item.args[0],ast.Constant) and item.args[0].value in ('--seed','--test-fraction','--forward-modes'):
            defaults[item.args[0].value]=next(ast.literal_eval(value.value) for value in item.keywords if value.arg=='default')
assert defaults=={'--seed':42,'--test-fraction':.5,'--forward-modes':'1'},defaults
future=ast.ImportFrom(module='__future__',names=[ast.alias(name='annotations')],level=0)
namespace={'np':np,'defaultdict':defaultdict}
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[future,node],type_ignores=[])),url,'exec'),namespace)
source_sha={}; summaries=[]
for model in ('Qwen3-0.6B','Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct','llama-2-7b','Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2'):
    directory=root/'models'/model/'calibration/real'
    groups=sorted(directory.glob('repeat-*')); assert len(groups)==5
    rows=[]
    for group in groups:
        marker=group/'BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE'; assert marker.read_text().strip()=='complete'
        source_sha[str(marker.resolve())]=hashlib.sha256(marker.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        files=sorted((group/'cases').glob('*/TP0.schedule_batch.jsonl')); assert len(files)==3
        for path in files:
            status=path.parent/'status.txt'; assert status.read_text().strip()=='ok'
            source_sha[str(status.resolve())]=hashlib.sha256(status.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            content=path.read_bytes(); source_sha[str(path.resolve())]=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
            for number,line in enumerate(content.splitlines(),1):
                item=json.loads(line); mode=item['forward_mode']; latency=float(item['iter_latency']); requests=item['request_infos']
                if mode not in (1,2) or not requests or latency<=0 or latency>30: continue
                assert math.isfinite(latency)
                assert all(isinstance(req['rid'],str) and req['rid'] for req in requests)
                rows.append({'case_id':str(path.parent.resolve()),'mode':mode,'rids':tuple(req['rid'] for req in requests),'identity':(str(path.resolve()),number)})
    for modes in ({1},{1,2}):
        selected=[row for row in rows if row['mode'] in modes]
        train,test=namespace['build_case_stratified_split'](selected,42,.5)
        train_ids={row['identity'] for row in train}; test_ids={row['identity'] for row in test}
        assert not train_ids&test_ids and len(train)+len(test)==len(selected)
        train_rids={rid for row in train for rid in row['rids']}; test_rids={rid for row in test for rid in row['rids']}
        shared=train_rids&test_rids; union=train_rids|test_rids
        assert len(union)==800
        summaries.append({'model':model,'forward_modes':','.join(map(str,sorted(modes))),'rows':len(selected),'train_rows':len(train),'internal_test_rows':len(test),'unique_request_ids':len(union),'train_unique_request_ids':len(train_rids),'test_unique_request_ids':len(test_rids),'shared_request_ids':len(shared),'shared_pct_of_all_requests':len(shared)/len(union)*100,'test_request_overlap_pct':len(shared)/len(test_rids)*100,'identical_rows_in_both_splits':len(train_ids&test_ids)})
for path,value in source_sha.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value,path
with (out/'upstream_split_request_overlap.csv').open('w',newline='') as target:
    writer=csv.DictWriter(target,fieldnames=list(summaries[0])); writer.writeheader(); writer.writerows(summaries)
with (out/'source_sha256.csv').open('w',newline='') as target:
    writer=csv.DictWriter(target,fieldnames=['path','sha256']); writer.writeheader(); writer.writerows({'path':path,'sha256':value} for path,value in sorted(source_sha.items()))
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'upstream_branch_head':branch,'upstream_url':url,'upstream_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),'parsed_defaults':defaults,'source_files_verified_unchanged':len(source_sha),'no_fit_gpu_or_formal_split_mutation':True,'scope':'Pinned upstream split function applied to OUR closed training traces; not upstream authors published accuracy/requests.'},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summaries))
